decisions.reason: Shows v0.9.2–v0.9.6 absent from the mirror via ls-remote-tags.txt and attributes it to the sync script pushing only HEAD:main, never tags; explicitly rules out network or typo and ties to attempt 1's resolution failure.

Uses dsh-version 0.1.1-rc.2 and compat-table (v0.9.7 → 0.1.2-alpha.1 with the useConversation seat) to explain the newer-client-API artifact on an older runtime; notes install success and restart prove nothing about API compatibility.

Pins v0.9.3 citing rc.1 verification and the additive rc.2 note, flags that v0.9.3 is also missing from the mirror, and makes the install command conditional on the maintainer restoring the tag; the commit-SHA fallback is explicitly marked unverifiable/not primary, no invented SHA, no runtime upgrade.

Fixes the script with explicit git push --tags / per-tag pushes to both mirrors, backfills the missing band, and adds an ls-remote release gate verifying every documented tag resolves on every mirror.

Replaces the single default pin with per-cohort install snippets keyed by dsh --version, manifest cohort declaration for install-time rejection, and table-generated docs; correctly restricted to the two tested lines, no newest-tag default.
